bio: Le Gourmet is accessed via the beautiful courtyard of a listed four-sided courtyard, which has been extended to encompass a hotel. Tables are laid out on the splendid terrace or you can dine inside, in a somewhat more private setting. On the way into the tastefully modern and elegant little restaurant, you will pass the glass-paned kitchen. Under the direction of Thomas Gilles, the kitchen devises a modern set menu built on classic foundations; there is also a vegetarian version. You can choose the different elements of your menu from the flavoursome dishes prepared with select ingredients. Or you might wish to plump for the Chef's Choice surprise menu.
